textRun.content: GULLYVERSE — SHARED CODEX / CHATGPT RECOVERY HANDOFF

One coordination document for the Gullyverse recovery process. Codex writes phase results and links to Drive files; ChatGPT reviews those results and prepares the NEXT task only after review. Actual work stays in the repository, and dated source backups stay in Google Drive.
CODEX_BACKUP_VERIFICATION: VERIFIED — 23/23 files; 275945968 bytes; full download-back SHA-256; independent restore PASS
NEXT_PROMPT_TEXT: SEE CHATGPT REVIEW & NEXT INSTRUCTION SECTION BELOW

The original Recovery Phase 3 task is COMPLETE and its source/checkpoint must be preserved. Do not duplicate it. The user has REJECTED visual fidelity of recovered pre-C9 stages and recovered C9. The merged correction instruction under CHATGPT REVIEW & NEXT INSTRUCTION supersedes the C9-only reply; Stage 3A remains blocked. Changing this document is not a Codex execution trigger.

CODEX: When the ALREADY RUNNING Phase 3 finishes, upload the complete report, screenshot PDF/gallery, Blender/source/runtime files, verification manifests and the dated external checkpoint to Drive. Re-download the uploaded checkpoint and verify hashes where possible. Then update CODEX_STATUS to READY_FOR_REVIEW, fill the document's URL/status fields, and set a unique CODEX_HANDOFF_ID in the format PHASE3-<UTC timestamp>-<short source hash>. Append your concise findings under CODEX COMPLETION NOTES. Stop; do not self-approve the artwork and do not begin Stage 3A on your own.

CHATGPT: At a scheduled check, read this Google Doc. Act only when CODEX_STATUS is READY_FOR_REVIEW and CODEX_HANDOFF_ID differs from LAST_CHATGPT_REVIEWED_HANDOFF_ID. Open the linked Drive report, actual screenshots and evidence. Review technical results, compare visual results against locked decisions, and append an assessment. Only then prepare a proposed next prompt under CHATGPT REVIEW & NEXT INSTRUCTION. Update LAST_CHATGPT_REVIEWED_HANDOFF_ID. Do not overwrite Codex's completion notes or approved older checkpoints. If evidence is incomplete, mark BLOCKED and request the missing items. Never approve visual art on the user's behalf.

USER: Visual acceptance remains yours. A proposed next prompt may be drafted after Codex's results, but Stage 3A must not start until you approve the recovered C9 appearance. You may leave comments or edits in this doc.

This Google Doc does NOT itself instruct Codex to begin a new task. Codex must be told to use it, and its environment must support reading/writing the same Drive file. ChatGPT's scheduled monitoring can check the document and post a review; it cannot guarantee Codex will spontaneously execute later prompts. Protect against duplicate processing using the unique handoff ID.
- Preserve existing C5.1 quarry dimensions/layout, fast travel, map, navigation scaffold, lighting/sky, original stage and crowds, and Aftermovie surroundings.
- C8 scanned Poly Haven material at the user-approved 3× feature scale is the material foundation.
- The user SELECTED C9 native-scale scanned rock composition as the visual rock direction, overriding the historical report's artistic preference for C8.
- Do not repeat the rejected C7 folded planes, failed C8 Boolean rock approach or severely stretched C6.2 source meshes.

- Stage 3A reconstruction must use the NEW approved natural cave and rocky tunnel concepts, NOT the old rejected Stage 3A art. No visible tunnel ceiling or hanging lights. Remove oversized physical GULLYVERSE text above the cave mouth. Recreate graffiti from exact user-supplied reference photos only. Preserve the C9 world and navigation.
- Old verified backups must not be overwritten. No destructive git operations, unapproved public promotion, commits, pushes, merges or deployments.

Phase 3 is complete and READY_FOR_REVIEW. Native Coastal Cliff 01 geometry uses uniform 0.9×; the approved C8 material remains 3×. This is a documented reconstruction on surviving C5.1, not a pixel-identical restoration of the missing C6.2 host. Public/default C5.1, lighting, layout, stage, navigation and protected Phase 1/2 backups remain unchanged.

Source: codex/navigation-board, HEAD 14f36da1a9b79a3b4926f7445bf0cde6c6c8f767; work remains uncommitted. Handoff suffix identifies the SHA-256 prefix of the verified Phase 3 A source/master/runtime archive: 48a6837464f9337d5ca0b02e77a99ba398d44ce2f6c6494cbb0154c1838bed0b.

Validation: typecheck, lint, production build, 88 immersive unit tests, five final browser cohorts, playback/navigation, ownership, failure/retry and WebGL recovery passed. All new local geometry/interface gates pass. Whole-scene visibility remains FAIL_INHERITED with seven unchanged legacy hits. Faceted joins, smoother neighbouring C5.1 surfaces and an unconfirmed initial direct-stage timeout/cold-load margin remain documented. Physical laptop/phone acceptance is PENDING; SwiftShader is diagnostic only.

Review evidence: 72 matched current screenshots, 21 historical reference images and six extra browser diagnostics; phone PDF 21 pages, full screenshot PDF 100 pages. CODEX_GALLERY_URL points to that full screenshot PDF. The offline full-resolution HTML/PNG gallery is in both C1/C2 review ZIPs, which must be extracted together.

Verified backup: 23/23 uploaded files, 275,945,968 bytes, all fully downloaded back with SHA-256 and ID/name/size/parent checks. Independent restoration passed all 277 project files, idempotent reapplication, preservation/rejection of unrelated user work and read-only opening of the packed Blender master. Restore requires the protected Phase 1 AND Phase 2 checkpoints.

Receipt SHA-256: 7a689bd6cc2dfa9a496445f6655b5ce536b99bfc1d8b469ad06c3a8571a26b07. The receipt covers 21 payloads; the later receipt and START-HERE index were themselves separately downloaded back and verified, making 23 files total. No circular self-hash is asserted.

HOLD: ChatGPT has not yet reviewed this handoff; USER_VISUAL_APPROVAL remains PENDING. Stage 3A has not started. No commit, push, merge, deployment or public promotion occurred. Keep the reviewer/next-instruction section for ChatGPT; do not treat Phase 3 completion as permission for the next phase.

Document checks: manual only, when the user messages (latest user preference). No automatic polling scheduled. Read the latest reviewed handoff, user approval and next prompt before acting; prevent duplicate processing with the handoff ID.
MERGED NEXT CODEX PROMPT — RECOVERY QUARRY FIDELITY CORRECTION (PRE-C9 + C9)

Updated 19 October 2026. User explicitly reports that BOTH earlier recovered quarry stages AND recovered C9 look worse/different than their original pre-loss counterparts. This replaces the older C9-only correction instruction in this document. This task is AUTHORIZED AS A PROPOSED CORRECTION PROMPT, NOT YET AN EXECUTING CODEX RUN. Do not start Stage 3A.

Restore the visual character of the ORIGINAL approved Gullyverse quarry progression, based on authentic pre-loss screenshots/PDFs, across the relevant pre-C9 stages and C9 itself. Do not compare only against recovered current images. For every relevant stage, provide ORIGINAL (pre-loss actual-browser image) → RECOVERED (existing current browser image) → CORRECTED (fresh actual-browser screenshot) comparisons. Prioritize fidelity in rock coverage, actual large-scale mesh silhouette, depth/embossing, 3× texture size, geology orientation/colour/roughness, seams and real visitor view. Passing builds alone is not visual acceptance.
REFERENCE ASSETS — ALL AVAILABLE IN GOOGLE DRIVE; NO MANUAL CHAT ATTACHMENTS REQUIRED
A. Newly uploaded pre-C9 ORIGINAL browser reviews (C6, C6.1, C6.2; plus REJECTED C7 as a failure example only):

Extract C6_original_browser_review.pdf, C6-1_original_browser_review.pdf, C6-2_original_browser_review.pdf, C7_REJECTED_diagnostic_review.pdf, READ_ME_FIRST.md and SOURCE_SHA256.json. C6 includes C5.1 comparison images. C6.2 report says art-direction change needed; do not mislabel it fully approved. C7 is REJECTED, not a design target.
B. Newly uploaded original visual reference / baseline pack (actual pre-loss site baseline captures and photographic rock/quarry images):
Read design/references/baselines/current-implementation/*.png and design/references/03-open-roof-quarry/*.jpeg, plus README. Do NOT mistake concept photography for a screenshot of implemented quarry.
C. Original C8 3× and original C8.1 historical material continuity screenshots, reports (previously uploaded and verified):

C8 evidence includes the original 162-page C8 review (many alternate 1×, 2×, 4× tests; isolate user-approved 3× pages), and the 44-page C8.1 material continuity study. C8.1 is a study, NOT automatically approved or a mandatory separate runtime stage.
D. Original pre-loss selected C9 screenshot evidence, 54-page actual-browser comparison PDF and visitor walkthrough:

Inspect the ORIGINAL C9 D panels, NOT the adjacent C8 B panels. Prioritize pages 2, 5, 6, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12–14, 17, 21, 42–45. The old report's 'KEEP C8' recommendation is superseded by the user's later selection of C9.
E. Original authored stage technical reports and protected visual pack:

Gullyverse_Recovery_Core.zip contains reports from Stage 1, 2A, C1/C2/C4/C5/C5.1/C6/C6.1/C6.2/C7/C8/C9 and an original visual pack. These reports are evidence of stage decisions; rejected experiments remain rejected.
F. RECOVERED/current screenshots and technical source checkpoints:
MANDATORY FIRST STEP — READ-ONLY FIDELITY INVENTORY

1. Download and checksum the reference archives, safely extract outside project source. Confirm original PDF/page, approval classification, historical camera metadata and exact currently represented quarry preview variant.

2. Build a stage/visual authority matrix: C5.1 (surviving approved public foundation with recovered original Blender masters), C6/C6.1/C6.2 (original private experimental comparisons and transitional geology evidence, not all approved), C7 (rejected), C8 approved 3× material, C8.1 (material continuity research, not automatically approved), C9 original user-selected rock appearance. Document which stages are actually implemented in current recovered runtime and which only survive as references. Do not invent lost stage states or mark rejected candidates as approved.

3. For C5.1, C6/C6.1/C6.2 and C8/C8.1 where direct matches exist, capture reference-aligned current-browser views and catalog drift. Some earlier stages do not have a recovered standalone runtime; in that case compare their original historical screenshots to the nearest surviving current host and record the non-equivalence. If critical historical originals are missing, identify exact missing files and remain explicit about limits. Do NOT hold up C8/C9 corrections merely to resurrect rejected intermediate experiments.
PHASE A — CORRECT APPROVED PRE-C9 QUARRY BASELINE / MATERIAL FIDELITY

- Preserve true original protected C5.1 layout, geometry constraints, world dimensions, floor, collision registry, lighting, sky, persistent Canvas, navigation, scaffolds and stage. Do not arbitrarily change this production baseline simply because a later exploratory screenshot exists.

- Check the recovered C8 threefold Poly Haven Marble Rock 03 / Rock Face 03 scanned material against ORIGINAL approved 3× shots. Material authoring (mask, colour balance, normal/ORM alignment, 3× feature scale and apparent blocky size) may differ even when numeric UV repeat matches. Determine the discrepancy using original screenshots rather than tweaking by intuition.

- Specifically inspect earlier C6/C6.1/C6.2 comparison pages for original broad host wall geology, bed orientations and colour transitions which gave C9 its composition. Avoid importing rejected 4.8×/7× severe source stretching or unapproved C7 plane sculpts. Use evidence to recover the visual massing and continuity through authentic correctly scaled scanned geometry.

- If correction is needed, create privately selectable VERSIONED new candidate(s), preserving existing recovered C8 and C9 to compare. Do not silently rewrite source baselines or claim the old C6.2 was restored byte-for-byte. Do not implement C8.1 as a product stage unless a clearly necessary aspect improves fidelity and is consistent with the approval history.

- Validate authentic geometry, UV/normal/baking/tangent frames, texture scale, visual seams, LOD interfaces, side lighting, wall-height continuity, apparent rock height, visitor-distance legibility and shadow/roughness. Note which parts derive from photos vs historical actual-browser images.
PHASE B — CORRECT C9, TARGET ORIGINAL PRE-LOSS C9 APPEARANCE

The original C9 had a BROAD, coherent dark brown-grey fractured quarry wall; the RECOVERED C9 looks like a narrow rock insert surrounded by oversized smooth grey C5.1 surface, with pronounced vertical boundaries, faceted transitions and coastal scalloped pockets. This is a visual regression that must be fixed, not a reason to abandon user-selected C9.

1. Treat original 54-page C9 PDF's D panels as the authoritative art benchmark. Compare actual ORIGINAL C9 screenshot, existing rejected recovery, and new corrected version at matching camera, FOV, viewport, DPR, quality, exposure and approved lighting wherever possible; label evidence as reference-aligned when exact historical camera metadata does not exist.

2. Restore broad credible raised fractured-rock coverage, correct upper and adjacent wall geology and bedding, physical relief beyond one ~9.5 m patch, and continuous excavated face. Avoid blank smooth walls, obviously pasted rectangular meshes, repeated scan tiling, steep planar collars, long artificial join strips, flat projected fake detail, arbitrary oversized rocks, and source coastal shell swirls dominating the front view.

3. Use real CC0 scanned cliffs and localized authored coherent geological meshes where needed, with source provenance and optimized geometry. Keep original Coastal Cliff 01 hero formation uniformly scaled 0.9×; preserve approved C8 material THREEFOLD apparent rock feature size and source map alignment. Do not reintroduce failed C7, C8 Boolean or heavily stretched C6.2 approaches.

4. The current C5.1 Wall_15 owner/host is not equivalent to missing C6.2 Wall_14, so inspect genuine world placements and protected boundaries; reconstruct genuinely good-looking C5.1-compatible wider geological composition. Maintain protected external interfaces with 2e-5 m gate where applicable, physical walking clearance and accurate scene ownership/disposal, without forcing false source geometry equivalence.

5. Iterate using ACTUAL browser screenshots under approved dusk lighting, plus independently labelled neutral geometry-only views. Update candidate only after seeing side-by-side reference/regression gaps; one successful build or screenshot is NOT enough. Retain the rejected current recovered C9 as comparison and rollback candidate.

6. Focus normal public visitor views as well as close/oblique/rim/ground joins and view from quarry tunnel. For the historical PDF, clearly distinguish C9 original D from C8 B and original C9 (pre-loss) from current recovered C9. Do not crop away blank areas to create false improvement.

Do not change quarry footprint/dimensions, valid navigation/collision envelopes, original lighting, sky/fog/exposure, map, scaffold, signs, stalls, persistent canvas, stage, Aftermovie, crowd GLBs, playback, camera choreography or unaffected geometry. No full quarry rollout/public promotion. No destructive git operations, commits, pushes, merges or deployment. Stage 3A MUST NOT begin before user accepts final visual fidelity. Future Stage 3A must target NEW approved natural cave/tunnel designs, no overhead fixtures/physical big GULLYVERSE entrance lettering, exact supplied graffiti, not rejected original Stage 3A.

Preserve all Phase 1, 2, 3 checkpoints as immutable rollback options. Do not approve the visuals on user's behalf. If strict geometry safety and target art conflict, explain and solve locally rather than relaxing validation.

Run typecheck/lint/production build, all immersive tests, Blender/glTF/LOD/UV/tangent/topology/boundary/sightline/clearance checks, browser navigation, map, stage playback/return, WebGL context-loss recovery, loading/failure retry and resource ownership. Explicitly separate inherited seven whole-scene visibility defects from new defects; do not loosen gates. Report cold-stage deadline margin and physical-device pending status honestly. Provide material image residency, GLB cost, draw calls, visible triangles, FPS and p50/p95/p99; SwiftShader is NOT physical laptop/phone certification.

I. Pre-C9 fidelity matrix: source PDF + original page, original stage approval classification, corresponding recovered view/limitation, corrected view, identified drift and actual improvement. Include C5.1 historical baseline and relevant C6/C6.1/C6.2 original screenshots, plus approved C8 3×/C8.1 comparison if applicable.

II. Original C9 → rejected recovered C9 → newly corrected C9 contact sheets (real-browser renders) for visitor, medium/close, sides, upper rim, foot, hub/scaffold, tunnel exit, aerial and portrait; show original C9 PDF/page number, exact pose metadata where known, and before/after visual gaps that remain.
III. Full resolution gallery and phone-friendly reviewer PDF, actual-browser walkthrough, source art/Blender masters and scripts/manifests, report with reproducible test/geometry/performance figures.

IV. NEW dated Phase 3-fidelity-correction Google Drive checkpoint with all changed/untracked files, original CC0 scanned sources required, runnable manifests and real LFS payload dependencies to Phase1+2, authoring/runtime assets, restoration README, SHA256, clean restoration proof, remote upload/download-back verification. Do not overwrite ANY prior checkpoint or historical source/evidence folder.

V. Update this same shared Google Doc with a NEW handoff ID, new report URLs, review PDFs, original-vs-recovered-vs-corrected comparisons, verified backup folder and explicit USER_VISUAL_APPROVAL: PENDING. Stop. The user's acceptance of BOTH pre-C9 fidelity and C9 fidelity is required before any Stage 3A task.

A verified, visually convincing restoration of the APPROVED quarry visual language leading into C9, and corrected C9 that demonstrably resembles the better ORIGINAL pre-loss C9 across multiple authentic screenshot comparisons. No generic redesign, no false approval for experimental intermediates, no premature Stage 3A.
